mapper.select: SELECT dl.id, dl.resource_id, COALESCE(r.name, '资源已下架') AS resource_name, r.resource_type, dl.points_used, dl.downloaded_at AS purchased_at, p.id AS post_id, p.title AS post_title, (r.id IS NOT NULL) AS available FROM download_logs dl LEFT JOIN resources r ON r.id = dl.resource_id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN posts p ON p.id = ( SELECT MIN(pa.post_id) FROM post_attachments pa JOIN posts visible ON visible.id = pa.post_id AND visible.deleted_at IS NULL AND visible.status = 'published' WHERE pa.resource_id = r.id AND pa.deleted_at IS NULL ) WHERE dl.user_id = #{userId} AND dl.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY dl.downloaded_at DESC, dl.id DESC
